title: review-run.json (one review run for a change-id)
description: The open record of a critique review under .dabbler/runs/s<N>/critique/<change-id>/review-run.json. Written only by router commands, validated before an atomic replace. change_id is derived from the reviewed tree/diff digest and is never supplied by a caller or chosen by a model. A remediation appends a linked attempt; it never rewrites a prior attempt's evidence, so attempts are append-only and earlier entries are immutable.

schema_version.description: Frozen at v1. A reader that finds any other value refuses the record rather than interpreting it.

change_id.description: Digest of the reviewed tree/diff. Structurally unchoosable by a model.

attempts.description: Append-only. A remediation adds an attempt linked to its predecessor.

previous_attempt.description: The attempt this one remediates. Null only for the first attempt.
